ERC-8286 frame 交易模块化账户
summary: Derek Chiang 披露，EIP-8130 与 EIP-8141（frame）之间的账户抽象合作上周破裂，Base 和以太坊将分别实现不同的 AA 标准。同日 ERC-8286“frame 交易的模块化账户”合并更新，EIP-8130 则提交与 Base 官方仓库对齐的两项规范同步。AnkushinDaniil 论证：公共内存池里的 gas 代付，在不锁资金、不靠链下信任的前提下无法兼得，这正是 EIP-8141 预留余额的原因。

items.note: 18:07（AnkushinDaniil）。如果想让合约为别人的交易付 gas，又想让公共内存池在不锁资金、没有链下信任的情况下转发，三者不可兼得；文章证明这一点并把所有变通方案归为三类，这也是 EIP-8141 采用余额预留的原因。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: public-mempool gas sponsorship needs escrow, a bond, or trust
items.note_en: 18:07 (AnkushinDaniil). If you want a contract to pay gas for someone else's transaction and the public mempool to relay it with no locked money and no offchain trust, you cannot have all three; the post proves this, sorts every workaround into three categories, and explains why EIP-8141 reserves balance.

keywords_en: ERC-8286 modular accounts for frame transactions
summary_en: Derek Chiang disclosed that the account abstraction collaboration between EIP-8130 and EIP-8141 (frames) broke down last week, and Base and Ethereum will implement different AA standards. The same day ERC-8286, "Modular Accounts for Frame Transactions", merged an update, while EIP-8130 submitted two spec syncs with Base's canonical repository. AnkushinDaniil argued that public-mempool gas sponsorship cannot work without locked funds or offchain trust, which is why EIP-8141 reserves balance.
